subject: Important Update: Your Flight Reservation
body: Dear [Recipient], We are writing to inform you of an important update regarding your upcoming flight reservation. Due to unforeseen circumstances, there have been changes to the departure time of your flight. Please review the new details and contact us if you have any concerns or need assistance with rescheduling. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding. Thank you for choosing our airline. Best regards, Customer Service Team
